examples.text: The boy listed several examples in support of his viewpoints.
examples.translation: 那个男孩列举了几个例子来支持自己的观点。
examples.speechText: The boy listed several examples in support of his viewpoints.

examples.text: The saying "Shared sorrow is half a sorrow, shared joy is double joy" points out the importance of emotional help.
examples.translation: “同悲一半，同喜加倍”这句谚语强调了情感支持的重要性。
examples.speechText: The saying "Shared sorrow is half a sorrow, shared joy is double joy" points out the importance of emotional help.

examples.text: The main purpose of this passage is mostly to report new developments in constructing（construct的-ing形式） quake-resistant buildings.
examples.translation: 这篇文章的主要目的是报道在抗震建筑建设方面的最新进展。
examples.speechText: The main purpose of this passage is mostly to report new developments in constructing quake-resistant buildings.

examples.text: Their genes were passed to future generations（generation的复数形式）.
examples.translation: 它们的基因传给了后代。
examples.speechText: Their genes were passed to future generations.

examples.text: Some stay very close to the words on the page; others take off imaginatively from the words, interpreting（interpret的-ing形式）, criticizing, analyzing and examining.
examples.translation: 有些人紧扣书页上的文字；另一些人则以文字为起点展开想象，进行阐释、评论、分析和探究。
examples.speechText: Some stay very close to the words on the page; others take off imaginatively from the words, interpreting, criticizing, analyzing and examining.

examples.text: We enjoy them while they are shut up in prison.
examples.translation: 我们欣赏它们而它们却被关在监狱里。
examples.speechText: We enjoy them while they are shut up in prison.

examples.text: A short message, a clear reason, and a plan to meet later often feel like enough.
examples.translation: 一条简短的信息、一个清楚的理由，再加上改日见面的计划，往往就已经足够。
examples.speechText: A short message, a clear reason, and a plan to meet later often feel like enough.

examples.text: Allow things to settle with time.
examples.translation: 让事情随着时间的推移而解决。
examples.speechText: Allow things to settle with time.

examples.text: When humpbacks live in denser populations, males looking for mates also have to deal with competing（compete的-ing形式） whales.
examples.translation: 当座头鲸的种群密度更高时，寻找配偶的雄鲸还得应对其他鲸的竞争。
examples.speechText: When humpbacks live in denser populations, males looking for mates also have to deal with competing whales.

examples.text: The Swedish app Gimi can give children basic ideas of finance.
examples.translation: 瑞典的Gimi应用程序可以为儿童提供基本的金融知识。
examples.speechText: The Swedish app Gimi can give children basic ideas of finance.

examples.text: Although the man is good at painting（paint的-ing形式）, we don’t think he is much of an artist.
examples.translation: 虽然这个人擅长画画，但我们认为他算不上一个像样的艺术家。
examples.speechText: Although the man is good at painting, we don’t think he is much of an artist.

examples.text: Nevertheless, the goal is the same--get the candidate who is the best fit for the position.
examples.translation: 然而，目标是相同的：找到最适合这个职位的求职者。
examples.speechText: Nevertheless, the goal is the same--get the candidate who is the best fit for the position.

examples.text: Dress to impress and wear professional clothes to look neat and clean.
examples.translation: 着装要给人留下好印象，穿正装，保持整洁干净。
examples.speechText: Dress to impress and wear professional clothes to look neat and clean.

examples.text: To maximize (最大化) the benefits, you can buy a pair of blue blocking glasses（glass的复数形式）.
examples.translation: 为了让效果最大化，你可以买一副防蓝光眼镜。
examples.speechText: To maximize the benefits, you can buy a pair of blue blocking glasses.
